caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet composed of two distinct sections stacked vertically. The lower section is taller and has a single large door with a simple knob, framed by vertical and horizontal wooden panels, and features slight curves at the bottom edges of the side panels. The upper section is shorter and consists of two small doors with knobs, also framed, and sits directly on top of the lower section with a slightly overhanging top surface. The wood is depicted in various shades of light brown with visible grain patterns, suggesting a natural finish. The background is a plain, off-white color with some faint spots. The overall composition centers the cabinet in the image, providing a clear view of its front and right side.
title: Baker's Cabinet
